# 4. Associations

## Check specific model 

### Kaplan-Meier and risk group definition

```{r}
cv_results_1 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/models_2025-07-31/BF_IMC_noGEN.rds")
dataset <- cv_results_1
surv_plots <- list()
data_out <- list()

for(i in seq_along(dataset)){
  res <- dataset[[i]]
  out <- cbind(res$actual_surv,chf = rowSums(res$predictions$chf))
  out_df <- out %>% mutate(risk_group = ifelse(chf > median(chf), "high", "low"), fold = i) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

  #Plot specific survival curves
  fit <- survfit(Surv(out_df$OS_months, out_df$status_OS) ~ risk_group, data = out_df)

  surv_plots[[i]] <- fit
  data_out[[i]] <- out_df
}

# Plot all curves for each CV fold
library(survival)
library(survminer)
ggsurvplot_list(surv_plots, 
                pval = TRUE,
                data = data_out,
                risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
                risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
                linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
                surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
                ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
                palette = "Set1",
                conf.int = TRUE
                )

## Pick a specific fold
ggsurvplot(surv_plots[[2]], 
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)

# Display averaged chf across all folds
data_comb <- do.call("rbind", data_out)

data_comb <- data_comb %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_chf = mean(chf)) %>% dplyr::select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, mean_chf) %>% unique() %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(risk_group = ifelse(mean_chf > median(mean_chf), "high", "low"))

fit <- survfit(Surv(data_comb$OS_months, data_comb$status_OS) ~ risk_group, data = data_comb)

ggsurvplot(fit, 
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)
```

### Importance

#### Feature-level

```{r}
variable_importance <- sapply(cv_results_1, function(res) {
  res$variable_importance
})

# Scaled importance per fold
plot <- variable_importance %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("feature") %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.),names_to = "fold", values_to = "importance") %>% group_by(fold) %>% mutate(scaled_importance = scale(importance))

plot$scaled_importance_total <- as.vector(scale(plot$importance))

## FOR IMC-only models
# Add feature information
plot$feature_origin <- ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_TU"), "TU", 
                            ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_MY"), "MY", 
                                   ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_T_"), "T", NA)))

plot$feature_type <- ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_EXP"), "EXP", 
                            ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_MC"), "MC", 
                                   ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_D"), "D", 
                                          ifelse(str_detect(plot$feature, "_INT"), "INT", NA)))) 

plot$feature_spatial <- ifelse(plot$feature_type %in% c("EXP", "MC"), "non_spatial", ifelse(plot$feature_type %in% c("D", "INT"), "spatial", NA))

# Define colors 
col_origin <- setNames(c("#825CA6", "#F2B342", "#317EC2"),c("TU", "MY", "T"))

col_type <- setNames(c("#1F78B4","#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C"),c("EXP", "MC", "INT", "D"))

col_spatial <- setNames(c("#377EB8","#4DAF4A"),c("non_spatial", "spatial"))
```


```{r}
ggplot(plot, aes(x = reorder(feature,-scaled_importance), y = scaled_importance, fill = feature_origin))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_origin)+
  ylab("Scaled importance")+
  xlab("Feature")

ggplot(plot, aes(x = reorder(feature,-scaled_importance_total), y = scaled_importance_total, fill = feature_origin))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_origin)+
  ylab("Scaled importance")+
  xlab("Feature")
```

```{r}
# Order features by median importance
ordered_features <- plot %>% group_by(feature) %>% summarize(median = median(scaled_importance), mean = mean(scaled_importance))

ggplot(ordered_features, aes(x = reorder(feature,-median), y = median))+
  geom_point(color = "black")+
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25")+
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "lightgrey")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

# Order features by mean importance
ggplot(ordered_features, aes(x = reorder(feature,-mean), y = mean))+
  geom_point(color = "black")+
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25")+
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "lightgrey")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

# Estimate step size of importance 
ordered_features <- ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median))
ordered_features$diff_median <- c(abs(diff(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median)) %>% pull(median))), 0)
ordered_features$diff_median_mean <- c(abs(diff(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median)) %>% pull(mean))), 0)

ordered_features <- ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(mean))
ordered_features$diff_mean <- c(abs(diff(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(mean)) %>% pull(mean))), 0)

ggplot(ordered_features, aes(x = reorder(feature,-median), y = median))+
  geom_point(color = "black")+
  geom_line(aes(y = diff_median, group = 1), color = "#377EB8", size = 1)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = "IMC_MY_INT_MY_Ag_M__MY_M2_like", color = "navy", size = 1)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggplot(ordered_features, aes(x = reorder(feature,-mean), y = mean))+
  geom_point(color = "black")+
  geom_line(aes(y = diff_mean, group = 1), color = "#377EB8", size = 1)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = "IMC_TU_INT_TU_MYCmed_mTORlow_PKM2hi__Endothelial", color = "navy", size = 1)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
## For top features - Add hazard direction information
metadata_selected <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/key_features_processed_complete.rds")

key_out <- metadata_selected %>%
  select(PID, status_OS, OS_months, all_of(top_features)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("PID")

out_df <- key_out

hazard_surv_out <- foreach(
  x = colnames(out_df %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), 
  .combine = "rbind"
) %do% {
  med_val <- median(out_df[[x]], na.rm = TRUE)
  group_var <- ifelse(out_df[[x]] > med_val, "High", "Low")
  fit <- survdiff(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ group_var, data = out_df)
  
  data.frame(
    group   = x,
    p       = 1 - pchisq(fit$chisq, length(fit$n) - 1), 
    obs_2   = fit$obs[1],
    exp_2   = fit$exp[1],
    ratio   = fit$obs[1] / fit$exp[1]
  )
}

hazard_surv_out <- hazard_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(ratio > 1, "high", "low")) %>%
  arrange(ratio)  
```

```{r}
heatmap <- plot %>% ungroup %>% select(feature, fold, scaled_importance) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "fold", names_from = "feature", values_from = "scaled_importance") %>% column_to_rownames("fold")

# order by median
heatmap <- heatmap[,match(ordered_features %>% arrange(desc(median)) %>% pull(feature), colnames(heatmap))]

anno <- plot %>% ungroup %>% select(feature, feature_origin, feature_type, feature_spatial) %>% unique()
anno$top_feature <- anno$feature %in% top_features
anno$hazard_dir <- hazard_surv_out$direction[match(anno$feature, hazard_surv_out$group)]
col_top <- setNames(c("black", "grey"),c(TRUE, FALSE))
col_hazard <- setNames(c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"),c("high", "low"))

anno <- anno[match(colnames(heatmap), anno$feature),]

median_diff <- plot %>% ungroup %>% select(feature) %>% unique()
median_diff$diff_median <- ordered_features$diff_median[match(median_diff$feature, ordered_features$feature)]
median_diff$diff_median_mean <- ordered_features$diff_median_mean[match(median_diff$feature, ordered_features$feature)]
median_diff <- median_diff[match(colnames(heatmap), median_diff$feature),]


pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/Survpred_FeatureImportance_Box.pdf", width = 15, height = 6, onefile = FALSE)
HeatmapAnnotation(
  importance = anno_boxplot(heatmap, 
                         gp = gpar(fill = "white"), box_width = 0.75,
                         height = unit(4,"cm"), outline = FALSE,
                         show_row_names = FALSE),
  median_diff = anno_lines(median_diff[,2:3], gp = gpar(col = c("black", "grey")),height = unit(1.5,"cm")),
  top = anno$top_feature,
  hazard = anno$hazard_dir,
  origin = anno$feature_origin, 
  type = anno$feature_type, 
  spatial = anno$feature_spatial,
  col = list(top = col_top,
             hazard = col_hazard,
             origin = col_origin,
             type = col_type,
             spatial = col_spatial
             ),
  text = anno_text(colnames(heatmap)),
  gap = unit(1,"mm"),
  border = TRUE
)%v%NULL
dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, CLIN_age, CLIN_gender, CLIN_pT_simple, PID_group_test) %>% unique()

covariates_null <- cur_surv %>% select(-PID, -OS_months, -status_OS, -PID_group_test) %>% colnames
multi_formula_null <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates_null, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model_null <- coxph(multi_formula_null, data = cur_surv)

covariates_full <- cur_surv %>% select(-PID, -OS_months, -status_OS) %>% colnames
multi_formula_full <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates_full, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model_full <- coxph(multi_formula_full, data = cur_surv)

#cur_surv is.na(cur_surv$PID_metagroups)

# Log-likelihood ratio test
out_anova <- anova(multi_model_null, multi_model_full)
anova(multi_model_null, multi_model_full)
write.xlsx(out_anova, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/supp_tables/anova_discovery_ecotypes.xlsx")
```

##### Disease progression 


```{r}
sce_prog <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas_full/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_T_07.rds")

metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_combined <- sce_prog$pT_combined[match(metadata_selected$PID, sce_prog$PID)]
metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_combined[metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_combined == "1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_combined[metadata_selected$CLIN_pT_combined == "3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_combined <- sce_prog$ISUP_combined[match(metadata_selected$PID, sce_prog$PID)]
metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_combined[metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_combined == "1/2"] <- "0"
metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_combined[metadata_selected$CLIN_ISUP_combined == "3/4"] <- "1"
metadata_selected$CLIN_necrose <- sce_prog$necrose[match(metadata_selected$PID, sce_prog$PID)]
metadata_selected$CLIN_PDL1_score <- sce_prog$PDL1_score[match(metadata_selected$PID, sce_prog$PID)]
```


```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID,TME_suppressed,TME_silent,TME_activated) %>% unique()

# Other groups
cur_test <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, CLIN_pT_combined, CLIN_ISUP_combined, CLIN_necrose, CLIN_PDL1_score) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% filter(complete.cases(.)) %>% t()

cur_groups <- cur_groups[cur_groups$PID %in% colnames(cur_test),]

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent","TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_test, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN","NOTSIG"))

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df$category)
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = c("TME_suppressed", "TME_silent", "TME_activated"))

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = c("CLIN_ISUP_combined", "CLIN_pT_combined", "CLIN_necrose", "CLIN_PDL1_score"))

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/Survpred_SurvArchetypes_DiseaseProg_Fisher.pdf", width = 5, height = 4)
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID,  TME_activated, TME_silent, TME_suppressed) %>% unique()

# Other groups
## Here GOI all 
cur_test <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, inflamed, excluded, cold) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent","TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_test, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.05 with trends

                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))
```

###### Mutations

Oncoprint 

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44
```



```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- mut_anno

# Filter for patients from surv prediction
snv <- snv %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID)

snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
Genes_list <- Genes_list[!Genes_list %in% c("SF3B1", "STAG2", "ARHGAP35")]

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))

# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for gene mutation clonality annotation per PID
subclonal_anno <- mut_anno %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```

```{r print onc 1, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=8,fig.height=8}
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  AMPLIFICATION = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[7], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[8], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 8),

)
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_genome %>% select(PID, TME_activated, TME_silent, TME_suppressed) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI clonal 
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_genome %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, GOI_clonal) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent","TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

Association with survival

```{r}
## Test assocation of mutations with survival 

sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5

# Only clonal
mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix == 1, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 

# Clonal + subclonal
#mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix > 0, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 

mut_matrix$status_OS <- metadata_selected$status_OS[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
mut_matrix$OS_months <- metadata_selected$OS_months[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]

#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(mut_matrix %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  mut_matrix[[x]] <- factor(mut_matrix[[x]], levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = mut_matrix)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))


cur_surv_plot$type <- "mutation"

#pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/Mutations_Survival_Bubble.pdf", width = 3, height = 4)
ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,ratio), y = type, col = ratio, size= -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = cur_surv_plot, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(p), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {

    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
```

```{r}
# OPTION 2: Selected impact variants across GOI genes
variant_combined_full <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_full_withmeta.csv")

#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- variant_combined_full

# Optional: Filter low-cov patients
#snv <- snv %>% filter(!PID_old %in% PID_kick_out)

snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_clean

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
Genes_list <- Genes_list[!Genes_list %in% c("SF3B1", "STAG2", "ARHGAP35")]

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))

# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for gene mutation clonality annotation per PID
subclonal_anno <- variant_combined_full %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```

```{r}
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5
save_sum <- as.data.frame(t(sum_matrix)) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
```

```{r}
# Intra-tumor genomic heterogeneity index (ITH)
## Driver mutations
ITH_index <- mut_anno %>% filter(Genes %in% Genes_list & cohort == "cohort_old") %>% group_by(PID, clonality) %>% dplyr::count() %>% ungroup() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "clonality", values_from = "n") %>% replace_na(list(clonal = 0, subclonal = 0)) %>% mutate(ITH_index = subclonal/clonal)

# Replace Inf with max(ITH_index)
```

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
cnv <- CNV_arm_sum_out %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain"))

cnv$type_final <- ifelse(cnv$type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss"), "loss", "gain")

# Optional: Filter surv prediction patients
cnv <- cnv %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID)
cnv$mut_level <- cnv$type_final

cnv <- cnv %>% select(PID, chr_arm, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- cnv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select chromsome arms 
## A: All chr_arm 
chr_arm_list <- cnv %>% pull(chr_arm) %>% unique()

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_chr_arm <- chr_arm_list[1]
pids <- unique(cnv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all cnvs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  chr_arm %in% chr_arm_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", chr_arm_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) |       #allow for multi-chr_arm mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", chr_arm_list, "$"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, chr_arm) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(chr_arm, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_chr_arm
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
#sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
#mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))

# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or chr_arm missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(chr_arm_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for each arm-level event per PID
subclonal_anno <- CNV_arm_sum_out %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain")) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = chr_arm, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$loss), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$loss), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```

```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=8,fig.height=8}
  gain = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#E41A1C", col = NA)),
  loss = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = NA)),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

names(col) <- c("gain", "loss") 

#test_alter_fun(fun_alter)
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_CNV %>% select(PID, TME_activated, TME_silent, TME_suppressed) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI clonal 
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_CNV %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, GOI_clonal) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent","TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])
```

Association with survival

```{r}
## Test assocation of mutations with survival 

# First two entries are mutually exclusive → combine with suffixes
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1, 0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5

# Build new rownames with suffix depending on which entry has the 1
new_names <- sapply(rownames(sum_matrix), function(rn) {
  if (any(mut_list_full[[1]][rn, ] == 1)) {
    paste0(rn, "_", names(mut_list_full)[1])  # e.g. chr1_p_loss
  } else if (any(mut_list_full[[2]][rn, ] == 1)) {
    paste0(rn, "_", names(mut_list_full)[2])  # e.g. chr1_p_gain
  } else {
    rn
  }
})

rownames(sum_matrix) <- new_names

# Only clonal
mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix == 1, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 

# Clonal + subclonal
#mut_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(ifelse(sum_matrix > 0, TRUE, FALSE))) %>% rownames_to_column("PID") 

mut_matrix$status_OS <- metadata_selected$status_OS[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
mut_matrix$OS_months <- metadata_selected$OS_months[match(mut_matrix$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]

#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(mut_matrix %>% select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  mut_matrix[[x]] <- factor(mut_matrix[[x]], levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = mut_matrix)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1], ratio = fit$obs[1]/fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% filter(p < 0.05)
cur_surv_plot$result <- ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "high" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(cur_surv_plot$direction == "low" & cur_surv_plot$p < 0.05, "DOWN_trend",NA))))



cur_surv_plot$type <- "mutation"

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/CNV_Survival_Bubble.pdf", width = 3, height = 4)
ggplot(cur_surv_plot, aes(x=reorder(group,ratio), y = type, col = ratio, size= -log10(p)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16,15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = cur_surv_plot, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(p), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
dev.off()
```

Association

1. Genomic subtypes 

```{r}
metadata_genome$genomic_subtype <- genomic_sub$genomic_subtype[match(metadata_genome$PID, genomic_sub$PID)]

## Genomic subtypes
metadata_genome$VHL_wildtype <- ifelse(metadata_genome$genomic_subtype == "VHL_wildtype", "1", "0")
metadata_genome$PBRM1_driven <- ifelse(metadata_genome$genomic_subtype == "PBRM1_driven", "1", "0")
metadata_genome$BAP1_driven <- ifelse(metadata_genome$genomic_subtype == "BAP1_driven", "1", "0")
metadata_genome$VHL_monodriver <- ifelse(metadata_genome$genomic_subtype == "VHL_monodriver", "1", "0")
metadata_genome$multiple_drivers <- ifelse(metadata_genome$genomic_subtype == "multiple_drivers", "1", "0")
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_genome %>% select(PID, TME_activated, TME_silent, TME_suppressed) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI clonal 
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_genome %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, VHL_wildtype, VHL_monodriver, BAP1_driven, PBRM1_driven, multiple_drivers) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent","TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

# Replace INF values with max
fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = c("TME_suppressed", "TME_silent", "TME_activated"))

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))

#pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/GenomicSub_Archetypes_Bubble.pdf", width = 5, height = 3, onefile = FALSE)
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
metadata_selected$cluster_mz <- metadata_other$cluster_mz[match(metadata_selected$PID, metadata_other$PID)]
```

```{r}
surv_out <- metadata_metabolome %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, metabolic_subtype_name) %>% unique()

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ metabolic_subtype_name, data = surv_out)

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/Survival_MetabolicSub_Archetypes.pdf", width = 7, height = 4, onefile = FALSE)
ggsurvplot(fit, 
          pval = TRUE,

          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups

)
```

```{r}
library(caret)

# One-hot encoding of variables
# PID group
dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ metabolic_subtype_name, data = metadata_metabolome, fullRank = FALSE)
encoded <- as.data.frame(predict(dummy_model, newdata = metadata_metabolome))
colnames(encoded) <- str_split(colnames(encoded), "metabolic_subtype_name", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
metadata_metabolome <- cbind(metadata_metabolome, encoded)
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- metadata_metabolome %>% select(PID, TME_activated, TME_silent, TME_suppressed) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI clonal 
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_metabolome %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, all_of(unique(metadata_metabolome$metabolic_subtype_name))) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("TME_activated", "TME_silent", "TME_suppressed"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

# Replace INF values with max
fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = c("TME_suppressed", "TME_silent", "TME_activated"))

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/surv_prediction/MetabolicSub_Archetypes_Bubble.pdf", width = 7, height = 6, onefile = FALSE)
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
dev.off()
```
